```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

RHMAintake<-read_csv("data/Copy of Master Nursery Intake Data - Reconstruction of RHMA Intake Data11.9.26.csv")

#select Columns

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  select(`Processed By`, `Planter Type`, `Collection Site`, `Collection Date`, `Date Planted`, `Tag ID`, `Mass (g)`, `Width (mm)`, `total length (cm)`, `plumule length (cm)`,`hypocotyl length (cm)`,`Roots (Y/N)`, NOTES, `Plant Name`,`Volunteer Name`,`Substrate Type`,School, Teacher, `Class Period`, `Part of Something`, Condition, `Hypocotyl Color`, `Float (Y/N)`)
```

```{r Factors}
#Planter Type, Collection Site, Roots, Substrate Type, School, Teacher, Part of something, Condition, Hypocotyl color, Float

unique(RHMAintake$`Planter Type`)
# "N/A"    "CC"     "ST"     "3\" TP" NA       "3'' TP" "3\"TP"  "4\"TP"  "4\" TP" "4''TP" 
RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Planter Type`=recode(`Planter Type`, 
                               "N/A"="NA",
                             "3\"TP"="3TP",
                             "3\" TP" ="3TP",
                             "3'' TP" ="3TP",
                             "3\" TP"="3TP",
                             "4\"TP" ="4TP",
                             "4\" TP"="4TP",
                             "4''TP" ="4TP"
                             ))
unique(RHMAintake$`Planter Type`)#looks good

unique(RHMAintake$`Collection Site`)
# [1] "OC"           "CP"           "STEER"        "SRM"          "AL"           "VB"          
# [7] "MB"           NA             "AB"           "PB"           "VBSP"         "STEER Fringe"
#[13] "LS"           "TB"           "SARI"         "SRBB"         "BB"           "MAG"         
#[19] "N/A" 

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Collection Site`=recode(`Collection Site`, 
                            "STEER Fringe"="STEER-Fringe",
                            "MAG"="MGB",
                            "SRM"="SR-M",
                            "SRBB"="SR-BB",
                            "N/A"="NA"
                             ))
unique(RHMAintake$`Collection Site`)#looks good

unique(RHMAintake$`Roots (Y/N)`)
#[1] "Y"   "N/A" NA    "N"   "y"   "G"  
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Roots (Y/N)`=="G")#only one of these, going to change to NA

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Roots (Y/N)`=recode(`Roots (Y/N)`, 
                            "N/A"="NA",
                            "y"="Y",
                            "G"="NA",
                             ))
unique(RHMAintake$`Roots (Y/N)`)#looks good

unique(RHMAintake$`Substrate Type`)
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Substrate Type`=="G/S")#should be mix


RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Substrate Type`=recode(`Substrate Type`, 
                            "G/S"="M",
                             ))

unique(RHMAintake$`Substrate Type`)#primo

unique(RHMAintake$School)
#NA                    "CAHS MIC FIELD TRIP" "CAHS"                "VIMSIA"             
#[5] "IEKHS"               "Antilles"            "cAHS"  

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(School=recode(School, 
                            "CAHS MIC FIELD TRIP" ="CAHS",
                            "cAHS"="CAHS",
                            "Antilles"="AS",
                             ))
unique(RHMAintake$School)#good

unique(RHMAintake$Teacher)
#[1] NA                    "MS. CALLWOOD"        "Mrs. Callwood"       "MR. CALLWOOD"       
# [5] "Mr and Mrs Callwood" "Mr D"                "Ms Troutman"         "Mr Tajores"         
# [9] "Ms Hobson"           "Mr Callwood"         "Ms Moise"            "Ms. Callwood"       
#[13] "Ms. Hobson"          "Ms Callwood"  

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(Teacher=recode(Teacher, 
                        "Ms. Hobson"  ="Ms Hobson",
                        "MS. CALLWOOD"="Ms Callwood",
                        "Mrs. Callwood"="Ms Callwood",
                        "Ms. Callwood" ="Ms Callwood",
                        "MR. CALLWOOD"="Mr Callwood"
                             ))
unique(RHMAintake$Teacher)#good

unique(RHMAintake$`Part of Something`)#this column looks like it was miscopied, notes mixed with part of something going to check it out in excel, reuploaded data much better

unique(RHMAintake$Condition)#not gonna do anything with this

unique(RHMAintake$`Hypocotyl Color`)
# [1] "G"   "BG"  "B"   "GB"  "N/A" "YG"  "YB"  NA    "GY"  "GBY" "Gr"  "P"   "Y"   "H"   "G/B" "B/G"
#[17] "S"   "GYB" "GR"  "BR" 

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Hypocotyl Color`=="H")

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Hypocotyl Color`=recode(`Hypocotyl Color`, 
                        "N/A"  ="NA",
                        "Gr"="G",
                        "G/B"="GB",
                        "B/G" ="BG",
                        "GR"="G",
                        "BR"="B"
                             ))

unique(RHMAintake$`Hypocotyl Color`)

unique(RHMAintake$`Float (Y/N)`)
#[1] "Y"   "N"   "N/A" NA    "F" 

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Float (Y/N)`=="F")

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Float (Y/N)`=recode(`Float (Y/N)`, 
                        "F"  ="NA",
                        "N/A"="NA"
                             ))
unique(RHMAintake$`Float (Y/N)`)
```

```{r Dates}
#Colleciton Date, Date Planted
unique(RHMAintake$`Collection Date`)
#there are two with two slashes, gonna fix, adn two that have years wrong
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Collection Date`=="09/19/02"|`Collection Date`=="04/14/05")
#should be 23 and 25 can tell by planted date

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Collection Date`=recode(`Collection Date`,
                                  "9//19/23"="09/19/23",
                                  "3//17/2023"="3/17/2023",
                                  "09/19/02"="09/19/23",
                                  "04/14/05"="04/14/25"))
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Collection Date`=="N/A")#214 NAs

RHMAintake$`Collection Date`<-mdy(RHMAintake$`Collection Date`)#214 failed to parse so were good, these were all the N/A

unique(RHMAintake$`Collection Date`)
#the dates run 2021-2025 looks good


unique(RHMAintake$`Date Planted`)
#11/24/33","11/24/23/" check these out so I can fix them before making them dates
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Date Planted`=="11/24/33"|`Date Planted`=="11/24/23/")
#should be 2023
RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(`Date Planted`=recode(`Date Planted`,
                                  "11/24/33"="11/24/23",
                                  "11/24/23/"="11/24/23"))

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(`Date Planted`=="N/A")#84 NAs

RHMAintake$`Date Planted`<-mdy(RHMAintake$`Date Planted`)#84 failed to parse, that tracks with the number of NAs

unique(RHMAintake$`Date Planted`)#2021-2025 looks good!

```

```{r Duplicates}
duplicates<-RHMAintake%>%
  group_by(`Tag ID`)%>%
  summarise(N=n())%>%#this tells us how many trees have this tag id
  filter(N>1)#and we are filtering for when this is >1
#only 6

duplicates<-duplicates%>%
  filter(`Tag ID`!="NA")

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(Duplicated=ifelse(as.character(`Tag ID`) %in% duplicates$`Tag ID`, #make a new column called duplicates, and if the Tag ID is in the list of Tag IDS in duplicates
                              "Yes", #fill the value in duplicates with yes
                              "No")) #if it is not the fill with no
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(Duplicated=="Yes")#10 duplicates

#checking the B theory.
checkdupe<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(str_detect(`Tag ID`, "B"))#278 have B, checking in with Adam to see if these were duplicates

#all the Bs are duplicates, he added B when there is more than one of the same number, need to make all Bs and the matching B less tags marked as duplicates

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(Duplicated=ifelse(as.character(`Tag ID`) %in% checkdupe$`Tag ID`, 
                              "Yes", #fill the value in duplicates with yes
                              Duplicated)) #if it is not the fill og Duplicated value

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(Duplicated=="Yes")#288 duplicates, math is mathing 


noBdupecheck<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(str_detect(`Tag ID`, "B"))%>% #find all the tags with B
    mutate(TAG = str_remove(`Tag ID`, "B$")) #make a new column with the tag numbers with no B

RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(Duplicated=ifelse(as.character(`Tag ID`) %in% noBdupecheck$TAG, 
                              "Yes", #fill the value in duplicates with yes
                              Duplicated)) #if it is not the fill og Duplicated value

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(Duplicated=="Yes")#now we have 518 math is mathing!

#check for any Cs
Ccheck<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(str_detect(`Tag ID`, "C"))

#marking Cs as duplicates
RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(Duplicated=ifelse(as.character(`Tag ID`) %in% Ccheck$`Tag ID`, 
                              "Yes", #fill the value in duplicates with yes
                              Duplicated)) #if it is not the fill og Duplicated value
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(Duplicated=="Yes")#now 522

#make a df that pulls the tag numbers out of the c, so i can mark the tag numbers without cs
noCdupecheck<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(str_detect(`Tag ID`, "C"))%>% #find all the tags with C
    mutate(TAG = str_remove(`Tag ID`, "C$")) #make a new column with the tag numbers with no C


#marking C-less C duplicate tags as duplicates
RHMAintake<-RHMAintake%>%
  mutate(Duplicated=ifelse(as.character(`Tag ID`) %in% noCdupecheck$TAG, 
                              "Yes", #fill the value in duplicates with yes
                              Duplicated)) #if it is not the fill og Duplicated value

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(Duplicated=="Yes")#now 522, doesnt change, that makes sense because these were already marked as dupes with the B

#now I wanna double check there are no lowercase b or c 
check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(str_detect(`Tag ID`, "c"))#no lowercase c's

check<-RHMAintake%>%
  filter(str_detect(`Tag ID`, "b"))#no lowercase b's either duplicates are sorted!
```

  select(`Tag ID`,`hypocotyl length (cm)`,`plumule length (cm)`,`total length (cm)`, TotalLengthCheck, difference, `Part of Something`,NOTES)%>%
